title: Presidential candidates mobilize with diverse schedule this Thursday (24)
subtitle: Interviews, debates, rallies, and visits mark the candidates' journey across different cities
excerpt: This Thursday (24), the presidential candidates' schedule included interviews, debates, rallies, meetings with supporters, visits to institutions, and commercial areas.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Thursday (24) was marked by an intense schedule for the presidential candidates, who divided their time among interviews, debates, and a series of public rallies. In different cities, the candidates participated in meetings with supporters, reinforcing their presence among the electorate.

Visits and presence in strategic spaces

In addition to political activities, the schedule included visits to institutions and commercial areas, expanding direct contact with various sectors of society. These visits were accompanied by motorcades that traveled through urban routes, boosting the candidates' visibility.

Communication and outreach

Throughout the day, press conferences were held to present campaign stances and strategies. In parallel, campaign teams distributed flyers in various locations, intensifying the dissemination of the presidential candidates' proposals.

With information from Agência Brasil.
